name: How long does built-in shelving installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does built-in shelving installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most built-in shelving projects take several steps: design, material selection, fabrication, installation, and finish work. Smaller projects may be completed in a short visit, while larger custom built-ins can take longer if paint, trim, or wall repairs are included. The biggest scheduling variables are design approval, material availability, and how much finish carpentry is needed on-site.
acceptedAnswer.description: Timelines vary, but custom built-ins usually take longer than basic shelving because of design, fabrication, and finish work.
